rules.title: S3 bucket allows public access
rules.description: The S3 bucket is publicly accessible; Block Public Access is not fully enabled.
rules.remediation: Enable all four S3 Block Public Access settings on the bucket and the account.

rules.title: S3 bucket is not encrypted at rest
rules.description: Default encryption is not enabled on the S3 bucket.
rules.remediation: Enable default SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS encryption on the bucket.

rules.title: S3 bucket allows unencrypted transport
rules.description: The S3 bucket does not require HTTPS.
rules.remediation: Add a bucket policy that denies requests where aws:SecureTransport is false.

rules.title: S3 bucket access logging is disabled
rules.description: Server access logging is not enabled on the S3 bucket.
rules.remediation: Enable server access logging to a dedicated log bucket.

rules.title: RDS instance is not encrypted
rules.description: Storage encryption is not enabled on the RDS instance.
rules.remediation: Create an encrypted snapshot copy and restore it as an encrypted instance.

rules.title: RDS instance is publicly accessible
rules.description: The RDS instance is publicly accessible.
rules.remediation: Set PubliclyAccessible to false and place the instance in private subnets.

rules.title: RDS instance has no automated backups
rules.description: Automated backups are disabled on the RDS instance.
rules.remediation: Set the backup retention period to at least 7 days.

rules.title: Security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 to SSH (22)
rules.description: An ingress security group rule open to the internet covers SSH (22).
rules.remediation: Restrict the source CIDR to known administrative addresses or use a bastion/SSM.

rules.title: Security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 to RDP (3389)
rules.description: An ingress security group rule open to the internet covers RDP (3389).
rules.remediation: Restrict the source CIDR to known administrative addresses or use a bastion/SSM.

rules.title: IAM policy grants *:* administrative access
rules.description: An Allow statement grants all actions on all resources.
rules.remediation: Replace the statement with least-privilege permissions.
